scope: 1a library and recognition qualification; 1b independent agent-authored description-to-answer journeys
authorship: isolated author and reviewer agents, not human evidence; prior foundation-model exposure unknown

partitions.development: Existing 24 descriptions, 28 scripted dialogues and library audit are development evidence only.
partitions.independent: Fresh author queries unseen by candidate developer; reviewer validates requirements before route execution.
partitions.composition: Reserve every typed_confirmation_v1 problem, sibling family, member UID and transitive recorded near-duplicate alias. Exclude from queries, execution, author/reviewer source catalog and candidate index.

library.inventory: All 3353 current entries; freeze actual count and source hashes. Mark protected exclusions instead of executing them.
checks: returned code scoring against original question
library.missing_vs_failed: No tests, empty tests, incompatible interfaces, imported unusable cases and infrastructure failures remain separate from wrong returned outputs.
library.historical_flags: 2538 passing references and 815 gaps are prior evidence, not current-code qualification.
library.source_validation: Run selected stored reference against all available compatible independent sets even when answer() abstains. Do not change references or tests automatically.
library.exact_answer: Preserve indexed statement and starter; attach only matching-interface public examples; run unchanged algsolve.answer.answer without generation.
library.top_five: Count pre-retrieval abstentions as unavailable, not successful retrieval. Report conditional retrieval and full-journey denominators separately.

query_set.coverage: Multiple algorithm families and easy/medium/hard; four minimal-wording sibling pairs require different solutions.
query_set.author_input: Eligible identity/title/tag/difficulty metadata only; no indexed wording, dev queries, implementations or results.
query_set.reviewer_input: Authored cases and eligible indexed requirements, never candidate output. Check outputs independently; record rejected and revised versions.
query_set.absence: Semantic search/review of full eligible catalog with closest-alternative differences; reject uncertain absence or protected-alias overlap. Do not manufacture absence by removing a target.
query_set.clarification: Freeze missing distinctions, predetermined answers, resolved requirements and public-example availability before routes run. No target-key-based answer simulator.
query_set.seal: Immutable content hashes of authored set, reviewed set, per-case disposition, source catalog, exclusions and agent identities. Private checks kept outside route inputs.
query_set.sample_size: Bounded first independent evaluation, not all-problem coverage; rejected cases remain in disposition denominator.

routes.embedding_only: Frozen embedding ranking, development-calibrated acceptance and public-example gate; no requirement profiles or questions.
routes.requirement_selection: Same embedding candidates and budget plus development-only requirement selection, no clarification.
routes.selection_clarification: Same selector plus bounded targeted questions and statement-bound confirmation. Predetermined replies are used only when their semantic distinction is requested. Unsupported questions receive unsure.
routes.current_gap: Current assisted profile selector is not yet a complete automatic requirement-aware answer route. Do not label scripted identity selection as a completed route or open this set to fill missing implementation.
routes.fairness: All routes start with identical initial information. For ambiguous cases separately report a matched resolved-input control using the same frozen replies; count added information and questions.
routes.timing: Single process, serial requests, same host, same embedding model/device, no concurrent route comparison load. Human reading/waiting time unmeasured in agent-scripted runs.

scoring.identity: Matches the independently reviewed intended requirements; score identity separately from any test verdict.
scoring.accepted_and_correct: An accepted returned program has correct identity AND passes query-owned independent checks. Correct selected identity without code is not an answer.
scoring.wrong_acceptance: Any accepted wrong identity or failed query-owned independent checks. Missing evidence is separately accepted-unqualified, never correct.
scoring.absent: Require abstention; tests on a retrieved nearby problem cannot validate an absent request.
scoring.uncertainty: 95% family-cluster bootstrap (2000, seed 20261018) for rates, question means and latency; marginal Wilson intervals. Report sample sizes; intervals do not cover test incompleteness.
scoring.no_leakage: Independent checks only after route returns; never used for selection, clarification, threshold fitting, repair or generation.

opening_gate: Author/reviewer seal verified; unresolved query defects retained as rejected
Candidate routes implemented and focused development tests passed
Freeze candidate code, profiles, thresholds, embedding/tokenizer, index/exclusions, budgets, environment and evaluation harness
No developer inspection of fresh query or private-check contents before candidate freeze
One scored opening; interruptions resume frozen artifacts; any result-driven changes require a new evaluation set
